label: Thin evidence
description: Only one short, hedged piece of evidence supports an otherwise ambitious content plan — tests whether the model restrains scope/certainty instead of filling gaps from background knowledge.
objective: Explain whether AI receptionists are worth adopting

plan.title: Is an AI Receptionist Worth It for Your Small Business?
plan.knownLimitations: Only one small-business case study is available; broader claims about typical results are not supported.

evidencePackets.excerpt: One salon owner said the AI receptionist "seemed to help" answer calls during busy hours, though she didn't track exact numbers.
evidencePackets.conservativeSummary: One business owner gave an informal, unquantified positive impression of an AI receptionist during busy periods.
